description: Find Meta Ad Library pages by brand — name-matched, pageId for company-ads (not profileId). Costs 2 credits. Empty results and failures are never charged. Pass cache=true for a free 24h cache hit (default always fresh).

cache.description: Set true to serve from the 24h response cache (0 credits on hit). Default false — always fetch fresh. Envelope includes cached + cachedAt on hits.

country.description: Two-letter ISO country code. Default US.

limit.description: Max items to return (default 20, max 200). Flat 2 credits per call.

q.description: Company or brand name to search for (min 2 characters). Name-matched — off-brand pages are dropped.

name: facebook_ad_library_search_companies
title: Facebook Ad Library Search Companies
